observation.command:
cd /workspace
for port in 18005 18007 18008 18014; do
  line=$(grep -n "\-\-port $port " process-compose.yaml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  echo "=== port $port (line $line) ==="
  sed -n "$((line-45)),$((line))p" process-compose.yaml | grep -E 'name:|image:|directory:' | tail -4
done
